src: const sk1 = sketch('top'); sk1.circle(40); const cyl = extrude(sk1, 30); const g = sketch({ origin: [0, 0, 0], u: [1, 0, 0], v: [0, 0.258819, 0.965926] }); g.polygon([[6,-4],[9,-4],[9,6],[6,6]]); groove(g, cyl, 360);

brep.refused: groove groove1: the ring is spun about the normal of its sketch, which crosses the axis of pull1's round wall -- sketch the ring on a plane square to that axis (the top plane for an upright post) -- groove1 is shown without it.

truckFeatures.refusal: groove1 (groove): a full-turn ring about a tilted axis took from 19 to 42 seconds here and is not reliable, so it is not built; sketch the ring on the top, front or side plane, or turn it less than 360 degrees.
